title: Gravitone's first release is the Arm Track-2 hackathon submission, not a public product launch
body: Operator decision, /mvp run 2026-08-05. Both surfaces (Python TTS service + Next.js studio) are in scope. Nothing is deployed. This re-scoped P5 sharply downward — SEO, legal pages and analytics were skipped deliberately — and raised the weight on reproducibility, claim accuracy, and the five-minute judge experience.

title: The public repo root is arm/, not the project — so no README rendered and GitHub detected no license
body: github.com/xkazm04/gravitone showed a bare listing (.architect, .claude, .perfect, context-map.json, gravitone/). GitHub only detects LICENSE at the repo root, so licenseInfo was null — and the project's own README states Track 2 requires a detectable MIT license. Fixed additively with a root README.md + LICENSE (commit 15d7403) rather than moving 500 files and breaking every CI/deploy path.

title: The Next proxy attached the backend ROOT key to every request, so anonymous callers could mint API keys
body: web/lib/backend.ts attached GRAVITONE_API_KEY (satisfies every scope incl. admin) by default; app/api/keys/route.ts was 12 lines with zero authorization. Any anonymous caller could mint, enumerate and revoke backend keys, bypassing the service's admin-scope check entirely. Fixed by making credential explicit and REQUIRED per call site (tsc now forces every route to answer), plus server-side Firebase ID-token verification with no new dependency — node:crypto against Google's public certs, since firebase-admin would demand a service-account secret every self-hoster must provision.

title: deploy/aws-oneclick.sh could not fail — set -uo pipefail without -e and no exit-status checks
body: Run with expired credentials, every AWS call failed silently and the script printed 'created security group ' (empty id), sat in two unguarded retry loops for 20 minutes, then printed a triumphant 'Base URL : http://:8080'. A judge on a fresh account would get a success banner and a dead box. Also minted a live root API key into gravitone/.gravitone-deploy-key — untracked but NOT gitignored, in the directory the README says to run from. A deploy script that cannot fail cannot be trusted when it succeeds.

title: aws/iam-policy.json grants Egress where the code calls Ingress, so port 8080 never opens under the documented profile
body: Unfixed, left as an operator policy call along with two siblings: neither launch path attaches an SSH key pair or an SSM instance profile (cloudformation.yaml says 'use SSM' but declares no IamInstanceProfile, so SSM never registers and a failed bootstrap is undiagnosable); and the CloudFormation path needs cloudformation:* which the documented profile lacks entirely.

title: Claim audit corrected the headline: ~270-500x cheaper on c8g, not the advertised 1000x+
body: Derived from the repo's own dated ElevenLabs price table. Also fixed ~2.3x to ~2.2x (4.26/1.9=2.24) and found a second self-contradiction: docs/SUPPORTED_HARDWARE.md marked all three boxes 'certified' while docs/certifications/ledger.json is empty on purpose. Rows now read 'measured'. Two claims with no artifact (+8% on N1, hosted convai $/min) kept but explicitly labelled unlogged observations. Landing's '27 built-in voices' corrected to 26 = len(BUILTIN) in service/voices.py.

title: pytest needs no ML deps — service/tests/fake_engine.py stubs torch/scipy/pocket_tts into sys.modules
body: An assessor assumed CI would need torch, faster-whisper and sherpa-onnx. It does not: the identical 1991 passed / 5 skipped result comes from a box where torch and scipy aren't installed. Separately, `npm run build` FAILS on a clean checkout without placeholder NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* env vars (prerendering /keys throws auth/invalid-api-key) — the assessor who reported it green had a gitignored .env.local. And `npm run lint` is a phantom: next lint with no ESLint config drops into an interactive prompt, which would hang CI.

title: CI gate authored and the two never-green workflows parked
body: perf-ledger.yml and sealed.yml (self-headed 'AUTHORED, NEVER RUN'; sealed-appliance failed 100% of runs at setup wanting an Arm runner) renamed to .yml.example. New ci.yml gates PRs and pushes to main with no path filter — the studio had never been touched by CI because the old filters excluded gravitone/web/** entirely. Measured lint would be 1 error / 4 warnings if wired, but eslint-config-next@15 is not flat-config compatible.
